_comment: aterm EFFECTS baseline (docs/DESIGN-card-engine-2026-10-19.md lane B0): per scene (episode, flowing, settled, typing, scroll), the GPU time as a reference full-repaint frame's p50 over the scene's (_gpu_rel), the reference's own against a blank full repaint (ref_text_gpu_rel), and the CPU work of the producer, the CPU raster and the GPU encode as frames per 10^9 instructions retired (_per_ginsn). BIGGER-IS-BETTER. The absolute figures and the pass-economy ablation are in docs/measured/effects-baseline-2026-10-19.md. Re-record with targo --unverified verify perf --record effects. Re-recorded 2026-10-20, and again that day when the card scenes took the card's line (its ink and star, as claude_card lays them) and the scroll scene a reply's distinct lines (aterm-bench 744ef96818): the episode's CPU raster, and the scroll's emit and encode, are those scenes' new work (docs/measured/card-engine-b3-2026-10-20.md, the third round). Re-recorded 2026-10-23 when the typing scenes moved from the bare glow engine (CursorGlow::tick) to the cursor family a window presents (EffectsPipeline::cursor_step on the frame's cells): the letter guard's per-pixel compositing is now priced, and is most of typing_emit (it is why typing_emit_per_ginsn reads 45, not 838). On 2026-10-24 the flowing scene (the card's flow after its intro, with prose typed under it: each step drawn, each key between two steps replayed) joined the gated keys, so the flowing card's emit, raster, encode and GPU time are judged and not only reported: its four floors are box-bfa4e9e0bd17f9a7's (M4 Pro 14c) record that day, and the other sixteen stay the M5 Max box's. On 2026-10-25 the flowing card's emit became flowing_emit_mean_per_ginsn, its frames over all their instructions, in place of flowing_emit_per_ginsn, its median frame's: a run's 64 frames are 32 step draws and 32 key replays, so the median of the five runs' 320 was the costliest of 160 replays and read 12,000 to 20,700 on unchanged code. Its floor is m11's (M4 Pro 14c), the median of four effects_harness runs that day (9,012 to 9,069, load 44 to 89); the other nineteen are unchanged. Re-recorded 2026-10-28 on box-4dea64151174cbad (M4 Pro 14c) when every scene's terminal took the engine colours a window gives one on Default (aterm-bench b879d6128f), so all twenty keys became that box's figures: sixteen had been the M5 Max box's, and the flowing card's four came from earlier M4 Pro runs (box-bfa4e9e0bd17f9a7's and m11's). Typing's letters are now Default's D0D0D0 on 111318 and its ANSI slots, not a bare terminal's E5E5E5 on black, and the letter guard holds them with less headroom: typing_emit_per_ginsn read 119 and typing_raster_per_ginsn 310 after it, against 169 and 353 on main at 517b8c1aec on this box, a move measured across the bench change and main's merge (bcc4b615c0), not isolated from either. Re-recorded again that day, once, on a quiet machine (load 11.5 at the lane's start and 12.0 at its end, on 14 cores, under the 28.0 the lane admits at), when the typing scene's cursor family took a window's config law and live cursor (aterm-bench f5782f170b). Against this box's run of main's 8ffb44c7da without that change, at the same GPU operating point (ref_gpu_p50_us 1172.8 in both runs, ref_blank_gpu_p50_us 700.6 and 701.0), the typing keys did not move (emit 118.995 to 118.993, raster 309.980 to 310.373, encode 832.335 to 830.301, typing_gpu_rel 1.930 to 1.925). The typing scene's knobs are not a default window's: cursor_trail_ms 650, cursor_trail_length 512 and cursor_trail_radius 0.4, where a default config gives 260, 24 and 0.6 (GlowHost::new). Of those three, Rainbow Kitty, typing's style, reads only the duration, so typing's figures are a 650 ms trail's. In one run each on this box at f5782f170b, a local edit to 260 ms, 24 and 0.6 (not committed) laid the same under and fx quads as 650 ms (p50, mean and max) and moved typing's emit and raster instructions by 0.11 % or less (p50 and mean), its encode's by -1.9 % (p50) and -1.8 % (mean). The card and scroll scenes do not run the cursor family; between the two runs their keys moved as noise, the flowing card's most (flowing_gpu_rel 2.748 to 2.207, the lowest this box has read; flowing_raster 3,219 to 3,415; flowing_encode 1,449 to 1,613). That record read episode_emit_per_ginsn 6,508 for the 7,022 of the one before it and scroll_emit_per_ginsn 26,582 for 31,590, as main's own run at 8ffb44c7da read 6,530 and 26,596: a regression in main's code, not a move of the bench's (nothing under crates/aterm-bench changed from bcc4b615c0 to 8ffb44c7da). A bisect on this box on 2026-10-28 (effects_harness --only episode,scroll, release with dev-seams, three runs at each tree) put all of it in aterm-effects fcb3a95bbf ('optimize effect_util, word_decorations, rainbow_kitty, kitty_cursor and cursor_glow hot paths'): its parent ef526385c9 read episode 7,040 to 7,066 and scroll 31,254 to 31,482, and fcb3a95bbf 6,394 to 6,409 and 26,120 to 26,828 (emit p50 141.5k to 142.1k instructions a frame against 156.0k to 156.4k for the episode, 31.8k to 32.0k against 37.3k to 38.3k for the scroll); bcc4b615c0 read 6,902 to 6,970 and 30,779 to 31,372, and de6ccfde6c, the next aterm-effects commit, 6,451 to 6,477 and 26,159 to 26,533. fcb3a95bbf with only effect_util.rs's lerp_rgb and mix_rgb restored to its parent's bodies, which drops the early returns it added to them, read 7,051 to 7,078 and 31,458 to 31,506, so those early returns were the regression (before the fix the trend ledger's best of ten on this box read episode 7,036 at 517b8c1aec and scroll 31,590 at bcc4b615c0). aterm-effects ea43b694c3 undid it by dropping the early returns fcb3a95bbf added to effect_util.rs's lerp_rgb, mix_rgb, scale_premul, fx_fade_x and fx_fade_y. Measured one at a time on this box (the same command, and --only typing,composer, three round-robin runs of each tree), mix_rgb's return was the whole regression: main at b0bba90814 read episode 6,448 to 6,469 and scroll 26,541 to 26,582, the tree without the five returns 6,977 to 7,040 and 30,815 to 31,331, and that tree with mix_rgb's return alone 6,434 to 6,491 and 26,364 to 26,903; the other four gained nothing measurable on the typing and composer scenes. Re-recorded that day after it, once, on main at c157dbe8e4 (ea43b694c3 merged), admitted at load 9.8 on 14 cores and ending at 18.7, swap 15.3 to 5.8 GiB: the two floors read episode 7,033 and scroll 31,502, the level before fcb3a95bbf, and flowing_emit_mean_per_ginsn 9,617 for 9,058 (the card's emit runs mix_rgb; not measured on its own). The other CPU keys are main's at c157dbe8e4 against 8ffb44c7da's. Two of them read below every earlier reading this box made, so they are not the run-to-run spread: flowing_raster_per_ginsn 2,791, 13 % under the lowest of its five earlier readings (3,308 at 517b8c1aec, 3,417 and 3,393 at bcc4b615c0, 3,219 and 3,415 at 8ffb44c7da), and typing_encode_per_ginsn 791, 4.0 % under the lowest of its five (870, 827, 824, 832 and 830 at the same trees). An uncommitted record of ea43b694c3 on its base b0bba90814, an hour before, read typing_encode 793 and flowing_raster 3,018 (itself 6 % under that lowest), so typing_encode's drop was already on b0bba90814 and two runs agree on it. That record took both for probable regressions in main's code (typing_encode in 8ffb44c7da..b0bba90814, flowing_raster in 8ffb44c7da..c157dbe8e4), not yet bisected, and kept them as floors: neither the trend (0.70 of the best of this box's last ten readings) nor the floor (0.45 of it) flagged them. Both low readings ran with swap paging (this record at 270 to 475 MB/s; the one at b0bba90814 while swap grew from 1.5 to 9.7 GiB), and the harness's counter (proc_pid_rusage's ri_instructions) counts every thread of the process; whether paging moves it is not measured. flowing_encode 1,474 is inside its earlier 1,347 to 1,652, and the other eight moved 0.7 % or less. This record's GPU keys were measured at ref_gpu_p50_us 612.3 (ref_blank_gpu_p50_us 382.7), the record before's at 1172.8 and the one before that at 645.0, so its GPU ratios do not compare with that record's (typing_gpu_rel 1.685 for 1.925, settled_gpu_rel 2.585 for 2.720). Re-recorded again that day, for typing_encode_per_ginsn and flowing_raster_per_ginsn alone, once, on main at c21127b4b6 on a quiet machine (load 12.6 at the lane's start and 11.9 at its end, 10.9 to 18.3 in 5-second samples between, on 14 cores; swap 0.8 GiB, with no swap traffic), after a bisect on this box named typing_encode's cause and found that code did not move flowing_raster: typing_encode_per_ginsn 809.550 (1,235.3 kins a frame at p50) and flowing_raster_per_ginsn 3,418.955 (292.5 kins); the other eighteen keys are the c157dbe8e4 record's. The bisect ran effects_harness (release with dev-seams, --only typing,flowing and --only typing) three round-robin times at each tree, each run started at a 1-minute load under 14 held 30 s with no swap traffic. typing_encode's drop is an unpriced side cost of a footprint fix, accepted here (that commit and docs/measured/idle-memory-window-2026-10-27.md price footprint and latency, not encode instructions, which this bisect measured first): aterm-gpu a9fec8d33e ('Compose the present copy by a draw') made the compose of the clean offscreen into the present copy a draw instead of a blit, because a blit on every frame kept the GPU driver's blit working memory resident in an idle window's footprint, and where the tray is not the copy's only writer, as on typing's frames, that draw is a render pass of its own ahead of the writers ('otherwise it is its own pass ahead of the writers'). A way to win it back, neither built nor measured: where the bloom writes the present copy, the compose draw could be the first draw of the bloom's composite pass, which targets the same copy, saving the extra render pass and keeping the footprint gain; which writer (bloom, shimmer or band shift) puts typing on this path is not confirmed. Its parent a8d626e868 read typing_encode 1,133.8 to 1,135.2 kins and a9fec8d33e 1,172.6 to 1,174.6 (+38.0k to +40.7k instructions a frame at p50 over its three round pairs, mean +39.1k, +3.4 %); on main's line ac5c4e10e5 read 1,201.3 to 1,220.9 and 1bb06efe6b, the merge that brought a9fec8d33e and nothing else of the encode path, 1,243.0 to 1,246.9; 8ffb44c7da read 1,200.3 to 1,212.8 (per_ginsn 824.5 to 833.1), b0bba90814 1,235.4 to 1,245.9 (802.6 to 809.4) and main at 8fb50d6ae6 1,238.8 to 1,244.7 (803.4 to 807.2), with the same typing instances p50, fx quads p50 and under quads max, so the 791 floor was that trade and about 2 % more read under that record's paging. flowing_raster did not move with code: 8ffb44c7da, b0bba90814 and 8fb50d6ae6 read 3,411 to 3,418 in eight of nine runs and its mean 1,319 to 1,322 kins a frame (flowing_raster_mean_per_ginsn 756.6 to 758.2) in all nine; the ninth, 8fb50d6ae6's third, read 3,082 (p50 324.5 kins; its five runs' p50s spread 11 %, slowest over fastest, where each of the other eight runs' spread 0.2 to 0.5 %), and its cause is not identified. Its own paging readings were 828 decompressions a second before it and 2 after, with no swap traffic, and the 1-minute load rose from 8.45 at its start to 14.88 at its end. The memory compressor does not explain it: the run before it, b0bba90814's third, read 3,415 with 13,311 and 10,386 decompressions a second before and after it, and 8fb50d6ae6's second read 3,418 with 30,088 decompressions and 63,677 compressions a second after it. Its p50 (292.5 kins) sits far under its mean and its p95 (2,559): its frames are two kinds (each step draws the card, each key between two steps replays it), so its median is the edge between them, as flowing_emit's was, and moves with a few frames' cost. That 3,018 and 2,791 were that edge read under paging, and not a change in the work, is an inference: it was not checked frame by frame, and whether paging moves the counter is still not measured. A first attempt at this record, on the same tree that day, was set aside: admitted at load 10.4, it ended at 126.5 as other sessions' builds started (it read typing_encode 811.1 and flowing_raster 3,285.5). Re-keyed that day: the flowing card's raster became flowing_raster_mean_per_ginsn in place of flowing_raster_per_ginsn, as its emit did on 2026-10-25. Its median frame is that edge (292.5 kins at p50, against a mean of 1,320 and a p95 of 2,559), so one disturbed replay moves it: it read 3,082 (10 % low) on a bisect run admitted as quiet and 2,791 (18 % low) on the c157dbe8e4 record, where the mean read 756.6 to 758.2 in all nine bisect runs, the 3,082 run included. Its floor is 757.907, the median of three effects_harness runs (release with dev-seams, every scene, as the lane runs it) on this box on main at ce56f147d4, each started once the 1-minute load per core had held under 4 and then under 1 (14 on 14 cores) with swap traffic under 1 MB/s for 30 s (1-minute loads 3.5, 7.8 and 7.7 at their starts): flowing_raster_mean_per_ginsn 757.9, 757.8 and 758.5, where flowing_raster_per_ginsn read 3,410.9, 3,407.9 and 3,422.4. The old key is still reported, not judged; the other nineteen floors are unchanged.
